warningAdjudication.note: The gate's soft-warning extraction was re-implemented offline and run over effort_bill_focus + headline against the inputs' bills_authored / speech_turns; it yields 39 lines (the gate reported 35 — the delta is granularity in the graph-props lookup, not a class the gate missed). Every line was re-derived from the arrays. VALID_SUBSET = 35: the whole legitimate class the reviewer expected — rapporteur-bill counts (Ožanová 5, Novák 5, Pařil 5, Babka 4, Demetrashvili 4, L. Vondráček 4, Benda 3, Pospíšil 3, Haas 2) colliding with per-term bills_authored, per-bill amendment counts colliding with amendments_authored, and per-bill floor turns colliding with speech_turns. Seven of the 35 are pure extractor artifacts with no numeric claim at all ("jednacího"→1, "jedenácti"→1, "Sedmihradská" containing "sedmi", "čtyřmi vystoupeními" tagged as bills). AMBIGUOUS = 2: L. Vondráček's headline "čtyř ústavněprávních tisků" (count right, qualifier wrong for tisk 72) and Jurečka's prior "prvním předkladatelem 4 tisků" (inputs carry bills_first_signed=5 and place tisk 89 in first_signed_bills, which the same sentence calls co-signed). WRONG = 2: both Benda's "jedenácti tisky" (effort_bill_focus and headline) — spoke_on_bills has twelve entries and the 51-turn total is not the quantity distributed across them (per-bill turns sum to 25).

summary: 16 proposals adjudicated. 3 CONFIRMED (Novák, Pařil, Babka), 12 NEEDS_CORRECTION, 1 BLOCKING (Okamura). No fabricated bill numbers in any NEW text — every 'tisk N' resolves inside that MP's own arrays (rule 5 clean; the only two nonresolving numbers, 266/267, are legitimate Senate print numbers in prior text). No company/money/ownership content leaked into new public text. Czech and gender forms correct throughout the new public copy for all seven women. The BLOCKING case is Okamura: the batch's neutrality rule for the two 10/10 signature-split units was honoured for Kršková and broken for Okamura, whose new text supplies an exculpatory structural explanation ('běžnou praxí', 'strukturálně očekávaná') plus an SPD club-chair role claim that contradicts his own current_effort_public_role (Speaker of the Chamber) and rests on one bare roster URL.
